description: Recent notable US federal contract awards — useful for tracking which public companies are winning government money.
name: get_government_contracts

actionableLongs.description: Long signals that cleared the scoring gate.

available.description: False when this call has no data — a snapshot that is not warm yet, a domain switched off, or an argument that was rejected. NOT an error, and NOT a statement about the market.

fetchedAt.description: When the underlying snapshot was refreshed (epoch ms or ISO-8601). Age matters: these are cached reads, not live queries.

limit.description: Row cap applied to every list in this payload.

fundamentalsConfluence.description: Whether fundamentals agree with the award signal.

hasFms.description: True when a Foreign Military Sale is attached.

rationale.description: Why it scored where it did.

surpriseRatio.description: Award size against the contractor’s run rate.

reason.description: Why the payload is absent, when `available` is false.

shortSignals.description: Scored sell-side signals; same fields as `longSignals`.

sources.description: Per-source status — which award feeds answered.

stale.description: True when the snapshot is past its refresh interval.

watchlistExpansion.description: Tickers the pass added to the watchlist.

title: US Government Contract Awards
